description: Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Washington, DC, Sayres Defense is a specialized government contractor providing management, engineering, and technical assistance services primarily to the U.S. Navy and the Department of Defense (DoD). The company focuses on high-stakes naval architecture, missile defense engineering, and fleet operations, operating as a mid-market player that combines small-business agility with large-scale stability. They have expanded their capabilities through strategic acquisitions of Joint Research and Development (JRAD) and Global Systems Technologies (GST).
business_model: Government contractor providing professional support services via federal contracts (IDIQs, Task Orders).
financial_highlights: Annual revenue of $16.5 million reported in 2026
Secured a potential $280 million U.S. Navy contract for Professional Support Services (PMS 300/PMS 325)
Received debt and equity investment from Granite Creek Capital Partners to fund acquisition of Global Systems Technologies, Inc.
Backed by private equity sponsor Broadtree Partners LLC
competitors: Leidos (Direct competitor in defense and intelligence services)
Lockheed Martin (Competes in systems integration and defense tech)
Radiance Technologies (Competes in government technical services)
L3Harris (Competes in maritime and defense systems)
value_proposition: Delivering mission-focused capabilities in strategy, planning, and fleet operations to support critical national security programs for the US Navy and Department of Defense with a blend of small-business agility and large-company stability.
rfp_strengths: Proven track record with high-value federal contracts (e.g., MDA SHIELD IDIQ, $280M Navy contract)
SBA 8(a) Graduate of the Year (2017) status providing historical procurement advantages
Deep integration into U.S. Navy and Missile Defense Agency (MDA) ecosystems
Specialized workforce with required SECRET clearances
Full lifecycle capability from acquisition planning to test and evaluation
rfp_weaknesses: Heavy reliance on a single primary customer (U.S. Navy/DoD)
Potential integration risks following rapid acquisitions of JRAD and GST
Smaller scale compared to Tier 1 defense primes
opportunities: Expansion into TSA and other federal agencies via GST acquisition
Growth in AI-enabled systems and advanced drone maintenance services
Scaling data infrastructure to manage expanding federal portfolio
challenges: Rising costs and supply chain vulnerabilities in the U.S. Defense Market
Need to modernize legacy-heavy technical stacks to remain competitive
recent_news: Acquired Global Systems Technologies, Inc. (GST) to expand TSA and federal agency reach
Acquired Joint Research and Development (JRAD) in June 2023
Awarded $280M Navy contract for Professional Support Services (2026)
Investment from Granite Creek Capital Partners to support M&A growth
